note: DEGSON 2EDGVC-5.08-02P-14-100A(H), 2-position 5.08 mm PCB terminal block; pin 1=VOUT_5V, pin 2=B0. Mating connector is J_FAN_MATE. External fan is Delta KSB0405HBF0D, 5 V four-wire PWM with tach feedback; power and control use separate 2-position connectors.
libraryNote: Old Phoenix component/footprint association cleared. Human PCB layout must create or select the DEGSON footprint from the manufacturer drawing, verify pad orientation, and mark pin 1; quotation remains pending.

note: AO3400A open-drain PWM sink: pin 1=FAN_PWM_GATE, 2=B0, 3=FAN_PWM_OD to fan PWM input. Keep the control ground common at B0.
1 kOhm series gate resistor from FAN_PWM_MCU to FAN_PWM_GATE; limits MCU drive and damps gate transitions.
100 kOhm gate pulldown from FAN_PWM_GATE to B0; keeps MOSFET off during MCU reset/high impedance. Off means PWM line released, which is the fan full-speed state.
10 kOhm pull-up from CORE_3V3 to FAN_TACH_3V3 for the fan open-collector tach output; limits pull-up voltage to MCU logic rail.
DEGSON 2EDGVC-5.08-02P-14-100A(H) PWM/tach connector. Pin 1=FAN_PWM_OD, pin 2=FAN_TACH_3V3; mating cable connector is separately procured as J_FAN_CTRL_MATE.
